subject: The gold in the Oval Office
facts: Since 2025: gold accents on the ceiling, the door frames and around the presidential seal.
Paid for by the President himself, according to the White House.
sourcesLabel: Sources: the White House via Fox News, Swiss National Bank, swissinfo, Bloomberg

us.label: The Oval Office
us.note: Gold accents on the ceiling, the doors and the seal. For everyone to see.

ch.label: The Swiss National Bank
ch.note: About 70% kept in Switzerland, in places it does not disclose. Some old army bunkers in the Alps now store gold too.

alternative.disclaimer: An illustrative comparison: a ceiling is not a central bank.
alternative.closing: *In Switzerland, gold goes inside the mountain. Not on the ceiling.*

verdictIntro: After careful consideration, the Swiss assessment:
endLine: Our gold is in the vault. Our ceilings are just ceilings.
